posts.title: The Students Who Found Their Way
posts.description: After years of teaching, I've learned that students' futures rarely follow a single path. A reflection on second chances, unexpected success, and why early struggles don't define a life.

posts.title: Sleigh Bell Assassin: A Thanksgiving Turkey Goes to Therapy
posts.description: Santa is invading November, and Tom the Thanksgiving turkey has brought his fears to therapy. Listen to the AI-generated holiday synth-pop song, read the lyrics, and consider a clinical lesson about evaluating extraordinary claims.

posts.title: Building Jonipedia in Obsidian
posts.description: I gave my Obsidian vault a Wikipedia-style front page, tested it on my Mac and iPhone, and packaged it as a starter kit you can make your own.
